## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in OLTS.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Spec clarification
- [ ] Proposal
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Example
- [ ] Governance/versioning
- [ ] Conformance/schema/tooling

## Review Checklist

- [ ] This preserves OLTS tool neutrality.
- [ ] This preserves product repositories as source truth.
- [ ] This does not require OpenSpec, a specific console tool, a database, or a specific UI.
- [ ] This does not make generated artifacts canonical truth without review.
- [ ] Compatibility or migration impact is described where relevant.
- [ ] Related issue or discussion is linked where relevant.

## Notes

Add any open questions, known limits, or follow-up work.
